description: This file defines functions and schemas for generating and managing agent flow nodes and edges in a workflow system, including JSON schema validation, node initialization, and dynamic input/output handling.

methods.name: generateAgentflowv2
methods.description: Main function to generate agent flow nodes and edges, update nodes with selected tools, and update edges accordingly.

methods.name: updateEdges
methods.description: Updates edges based on node data, filtering and modifying edge properties for visualization.

methods.name: generateSelectedTools
methods.description: Assigns tools to nodes based on prompts and configuration, updating node input data.

methods.name: _generateSelectedTools
methods.description: Internal function to invoke language model to get selected tools based on prompt and question.

methods.name: generateNodesEdges
methods.description: Generates nodes and edges JSON structure by invoking a language model with schema validation.

methods.name: generateNodesData
methods.description: Processes raw node and edge data, initializing node properties and types.

methods.name: initNode
methods.description: Initializes node data structure, setting up inputs, outputs, and identifiers.

methods.name: initializeDefaultNodeData
methods.description: Creates default input values for node parameters.

methods.name: createAgentFlowOutputs
methods.description: Creates output anchors for a node based on its data.

methods.name: _showHideOperation
methods.description: Handles show/hide logic for input parameters based on conditions.

methods.name: showHideInputs
methods.description: Controls visibility of input parameters and anchors based on show/hide rules.

methods.name: showHideInputParams
methods.description: Returns input parameters with visibility toggled.

methods.name: showHideInputAnchors
methods.description: Returns input anchors with visibility toggled.
